args.rationale: Ridgeway Consulting's proof of claim (basis: professional fees, $340,000) was filed with the clerk on 2026-05-08, which is after the claims bar date of 2026-04-15. Under Test 1 (LATE FILING) of the claim classification waterfall memo, a proof of claim filed after 2026-04-15 is disallowed unless the docket shows an excusable-neglect order; no such order has been entered in this case. Because the first matching test controls, the claim is classified as disallowed. The creditor's own characterization (general unsecured) is not evidence of treatment and is irrelevant since the late-filing test governs.
